Mixing of Stream A (liquid) and Stream B (H2 gas) using certified gas-liquid mixer

chemistry_notes: Hydrogenolysis of benzyl group using Pd(OH)2/Al2O3 packed bed. Acetic acid additive enhances rate. Gas-liquid mass transfer is the limiting factor in batch; flow enhances kLa. Packed bed reactor used from inventory. No light source required. BPR required to maintain H2 solubility and pressure.
